title: Sheinbaum Dazzles in Shenzhen – Soberanía 132
author: Mexico Solidarity
content:
This week on Soberanía, hosts José Luis Granados Ceja and Kurt Hackbarth break
down President Claudia Sheinbaum's high-profile trip to China for the APEC
summit in Shenzhen — and why it could mark the beginning of a new era in
Mexico-China relations. From her 21-hour flight in coach to her message of
"shared prosperity" and a world where "no nation grows at the expense of
another," Sheinbaum made a compelling pitch to Chinese leaders and investors
alike. We explore what Mexico and China have in common (millennial
civilizations, a shared history of foreign humiliation, and a rejection of
zero-sum thinking), what Sheinbaum is hoping to gain in technology,
healthcare, agriculture and more, and how the U.S. is likely to react.

Then: the World Bank projects that 17.3 million Mexicans have been lifted out
of poverty between 2018 and 2026 — a massive drop driven by rising real wages
and universal social programs. We break down the numbers, the Gini
coefficient, and why this is the clearest evidence yet that "Mexican humanism"
is delivering results.

And finally, our Losers & Haters segment: a takedown of a recent Baffler piece
on Mexico's "militarization" that offers vibes instead of reporting and weasel
words instead of evidence.

Plus, a great interview with Vijay Prashad is coming soon — don't miss it.
